Dictated by the covering clinician for the teaching file; reviewed for spelling.

S: The patient reports nighttime tingling in both hands that wakes her, worse after knitting, shaken loose by dangling the arms. No neck pain.
O: Vitals: temperature 36.8 C, pulse 72, respirations 14, blood pressure 121/77, oxygen saturation 99 percent on room air. Both hands show no wasting; grip strength is full; tapping the wrist tingles the fingers on both sides.
A: Hand tingling from nerve irritation at the wrist.
P: Night wrist splints for both hands and no knitting for two weeks. Return if the tingling becomes constant or the hands weaken.
rationale: Clerical preamble precedes the headers. Preamble text belongs to no section and must not break detection: all criteria present. Overall complete.
